notes: Source: Kemendikdasmen Pusdatin Data Referensi. The old referensi.data.kemdikbud.go.id domain no longer resolves; the site now lives at referensi.data.kemendikdasmen.go.id. I opened the pages directly (curl) on 2026-10-12. Filter: Jalur Formal, Bentuk Pendidikan = SMK (id 15), Status = all / negeri (s1) / swasta (s2). URLs: .../pendidikan/dikmen/000000/0/jf/15/all, .../jf/15/s1, .../jf/15/s2. National: 14,445 SMK (3,813 negeri + 10,632 swasta, which add up exactly). One of these, a negeri SMK, is listed under 'Luar Negeri' (abroad), so the 38 provinces alone total 14,444 (3,812 negeri + 10,632 swasta). Period caveat: Data Referensi is a live registry and the page shows no semester or cut-off label. Treat it as a snapshot from 12 Oct 2026, not as a named Dapodik semester. Dapodik (dapo.kemendikdasmen.go.id) could not be opened: it returns HTTP 403 behind a bot-detection challenge (SafeLine WAF), which I did not try to bypass. So there is no cross-check against a named Dapodik semester. Definitional caveat: the default 'SMK (Sederajat)' column on the unfiltered page is slightly higher (for example, Jakarta 560 vs 559) because it also counts MAK and similar vocational school types. The numbers here are pure SMK. These are counts of existing registered schools (potential reach), not AIoT partner schools. I did not write any files in the repo; raw HTML is in the scratchpad at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-macbook-Documents-GPT-Project-iot-ai-id-public/30b119ae-cf49-43dd-95ad-515a4fa511f3/scratchpad/ref/.

FINDINGS
- All 17 hotspot counts come from the official Data Referensi site, filtered to Jalur Formal, bentuk SMK (code 15), all statuses. The counts cover existing SMK only, both public and private. They show potential reach, not partner schools.
- The old domain referensi.data.kemdikbud.go.id no longer resolves (DNS failure). The data now lives at referensi.data.kemendikdasmen.go.id.
- URL pattern: /pendidikan/dikmen/{provinceCode}/1/jf/15/all gives a province broken down by kab/kota. The kab/kota drill-down is /pendidikan/dikmen/{kabCode}/2/jf/15/all.
- Each per-area number is copied directly from the province page. Multi-area hotspots are summed by us; the parts are listed in "area".

PERIOD
- The Data Referensi pages show no semester or date label. They are a live Dapodik-fed snapshot, read on 2026-10-12, and the counts can change slightly over time.
- If a semester is needed, label it "Data Referensi Kemendikdasmen, accessed 12 Oct 2026".
- dapo.kemendikdasmen.go.id returned HTTP 403, so the counts could not be cross-checked against Dapodik.

SMK VS SMK (SEDERAJAT)
- The unfiltered dikmen page reports "SMK (Sederajat)", which also counts MAK and similar schools. For example, DKI shows 560 there versus 559 for SMK only.
- The numbers above are SMK only.

ROBOTICS / IoT PROGRAM COUNTS
- I could not find an official national count of SMK offering Teknik Mekatronika, Teknik Elektronika Industri, or TKJ/TJKT. Searches turned up only journals and regional documents.
- An internal-portal.kemdikbud.go.id PDF that reportedly lists those concentrations could not be text-extracted (no PDF tools available), so it is not cited.
- I also found no official current total of SMK Pusat Keunggulan schools. A 2025 target of 1,100 + 78 SMK appeared only on a non-official blog (gebrak.id) and was not used.
- Recommendation: don't put any Mekatronika or TKJ count on the site until it can be pulled from Dapodik or Data Referensi by kompetensi keahlian.

CONTEXT
- A single headline line works: "14,445 SMK nationwide" (official Data Referensi total, computed). The hotspots cover 2,420 SMK in total, which is about 17% of the national figure.
